Synopsis:
Crimson the dinosaur is one of the animals who will participate in the doppelganger-dribbles attack. Player can examine him and realise Crimson isn't angry, he's starving. If the player feeds him some meat, he is so busy eating during the attack that he doesn't participate.In the bottom branch, he's so hungry that he's on the brink of losing his mind - he's snapping, furious, and all he craves is meat.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_Circus_Beast_02.json: Crimson is a dinosaur the player encounters who is slated to join the incoming doppelganger‑dribbles attack. On inspection the creature’s pale gums and hollow eyes make it clear he isn’t enraged so much as starving — if the player feeds him meat he becomes preoccupied eating and will not take part in the assault. The scene supports player options like mimicking the beast’s posture or examining him, which trigger the “starving, not angry” observation and allow responses such as promising to return with food or taunting him. In a darker branch (not shown in every sample) his hunger has driven him nearly mad and intensely violent, craving only meat.
- WYR_Circus_Beast_01.json: Shadow the displacer beast is one of the animals who will participate in the doppelganger-dribbles attack. Player can try (and fail) to calm her, and realise the only way to stop her is to break the cage lock and trap her.
- CAMP_AstarionHunger_SCO_Companion.json: You wake up and find Astarion hunching over you, fangs bared. You fight him off. Caught off guard, he's alarmed and worried that you're going to kill him. He tries to be charming, explaining that he's too weak without blood. If you push back against his excuses he gets frustrated - he tries to bargain with you. If you agree to let him bite you, he's thrilled. He feels in control again. After drinking, he feels invigorated and cocky.
- WYR_Circus_Clown_PreShow_Companions.json: This node is the follow‑up to the circus pre‑show sequence that starts after the player picks one of their companions to go onstage (possible companions include Shadowheart, Astarion, Wyll, Gale, Lae'zel, Karlach, Jaheira, Minsc, Minthara or Halsin). Off‑screen the chosen companion has climbed onto the stage and Dribbles is playing up the moment to the crowd with a syrupy, childlike patter. His tone suddenly turns vicious and cultish — he leans in, whispers “Praise the Absolute,” and then his beast (a dog) lunges at the companion. A cinematic cut shows the companion hit, beginning the combat prone and injured; this dialog was separated to keep that cinematic beat intact.
- CAMP_Astarion_CRD_TastingParty.json: Astarion is staring at the other companions around the campfire. He's friendly and affable, but his mind is on his hunger. He starts to wonder what the others taste like, although he's MOSTLY joking. In the end he decides to remove himself, before the conversation gets too real.

context: Crimson is a circus dinosaur poised to join Dribbles’ doppelganger‑dribbles attack, so he initially presents with a cold, ferocious stare and bared teeth. If the player inspects or mimics his posture, visual clues (hollow eyes, pale gums) make it clear he isn’t enraged so much as starving. The player can promise to fetch food or taunt him in that moment, and if they feed him meat he becomes preoccupied eating and won’t take part in the assault. In a darker branch his hunger has nearly driven him mad, making him far more violent and single‑minded about getting meat.
